msg: Hi, I apologize for the lengthy and detailed clues to this game, but it is important for your success.  Believe me, you will want to pay attention!  The gnomes will appear in colored pairs.  The gnomes appear in orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, and blue and purple.  The gnomes positions will change so do not mind that, but they will always be in those pairs.  Each pair will go to either a red basket or a yellow basket.  I think the basket you choose will lead to more mushrooms.  At first, I thought a certain color got more mushrooms, but now I think it has to do with the basket color. Remember, color and amount of mushrooms always change, so do not expect to get the same score based on color.  To succeed in this game, you want to get as many mushrooms as possible, based on colored gnomes and baskets.  Here are some hints that may help you.  The orange, green, red, and blue gnomes will take you to the red baskets.  The brown, pink, yellow, and purple gnomes will take you to the yellow baskets.  You only have 1.5 seconds to choose a colored gnome, then it will immediately take you to another screen, where you have to 1.5 seconds to hit the space bar, wherein it will tell you how many mushrooms you scored.  Pay attention to the colors of gnomes and baskets.  Do not be deterred with color - mushroom number.  ( I said before, the number of mushrooms and color will always change.)  Remember, the game will try to trick you with different hat sizes and gnome sizes.  Those do not matter.  Always pay attention to the colors of the gnomes and the baskets.  They will be the clues that lead you to the most mushrooms.  Also, as I said previously, use those breaks to think about basket color and number of mushrooms.  You will have several attempts to get better at mushrooms-color combinations.  Stay focused and good luck to you!
